opening.argument: The presentation ties income to entry into the system and to activity within its partner structure. The narrator says, “you first open your 2 slots when you activate the account and you will get earning,” while the displayed platform states that marketing income depends on the level where partners take a spot, with higher levels producing more income. The reward diagram further routes first-, second-, and third-line distributions through upline partners. The xGold card reinforces that recruitment-linked structure with “4 lines, 30 partners, 1020% per cycle” alongside paid activation and upgrade buttons for 10 and 15 BUSD. These materials establish the promised earning mechanism, though the sampled wallet screen does not prove a completed transfer or realized earnings.
